name: ui-audit-loop
source_cases: Target-selection UI passed DOM E2E while target assets were visually broken

changelog.change: Created a same-source runtime screenshot audit loop with hard visual failures and mandatory implementation iteration.
Passed official skill validation and five positive, negative, and boundary evaluation cases; review approved for incubating use.
Added composition-axis auditing after a centered target passed while its command bar remained horizontally offset.
Extended readable showcase checks from card spotlights to opponent skill / upgrade-card showcases so short auto-dismiss timers fail UI audit.
